intent: new independent asset using style inputs
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one independent raster game component icon, not a panel or illustration of the whole board.
Reference roles: Image 1 is the selected B copper-ink formation board, the HIGHEST visual style authority only. Image 2 is a sibling ward component, for consistent ink weight, flat top-down construction, palette and short copper-jaw sockets. Image 3 is a sibling splitter, for the same broad brush-painted copper/gray-jade shapes and three-port vocabulary. These are style/family references, NOT edit targets. Do not reproduce the board or existing components.
Style: match this exact Chinese xianxia game's hand-painted ink icon family. Strong irregular charcoal-black ink contour, broad simplified flat low-saturation gray-brown ancient copper and gray-green jade color masses, dry-brush scumble, small ivory-white bevel edges. Painted two-dimensional read, sparse detail and a strong silhouette readable at 64 px; no photographic metal, realistic microtexture or glossy 3D relief.
View: strictly 90-degree orthographic directly overhead, all pieces lying flat. No camera tilt or visible tall vertical front/side walls.
Backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha outside the object and in open gaps, no black/white colored background, no floor shadow, no floating glow. Center the complete single object with a safe transparent margin.
No writing, letters, numbers, arrows, modern electronic symbols, grid, modern PCB, chip legs, shield silhouette, jewelry, game UI button frame, surrounding board, free wires outside the object, or extra colored attachment points.
Subject: a compact low-lying ancient copper gate mechanism, one square 1:1 canvas, 1x1 candidate footprint. A small cut-corner copper saddle holds a single broad muted gray-green jade shutter slab sliding in a short north-south guide. The physical jade gate interrupts or permits a west-to-east shallow cinnabar-red passage, clearly suggesting a real gate that can allow or block rather than an abstract logo. Keep the body compact and asymmetrical enough to read as a tool, not a square button.
Exactly THREE functional mouths: at the WEST edge midpoint a short cinnabar event inlet between two tiny pale copper jaws; at the NORTH edge midpoint a short cinnabar permission inlet into the shutter actuator; at the EAST edge midpoint a matching short cinnabar event outlet. West and east mouths share precisely the same horizontal axis; north mouth is centered. All three mouths are part of the object perimeter and open outwards. The north control groove terminates at the shutter mechanism, not a free T wire across the jade. The south edge is fully closed, no fourth port. Copper jaws are short, not long wires. Leave no ambiguous decorative ears. No green/gold energy socket.

local_edit.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the supplied gate component PNG, a hand-painted ancient copper and gray-green jade formation switch on genuine transparent alpha.
Change ONLY the engraved dark angular symbol in the center of the sliding jade shutter slab. Remove the entire symbol and fill that small area with the same plain muted gray-green dry-brush jade color and natural brush shading as the surrounding shutter surface. The jade must be absolutely blank: no engraving, line symbol, letter, numeral, rune, crack logo, or replacement mark.
Keep EVERYTHING ELSE unchanged: exact square native framing, transparency, ink contour, overhead viewpoint, complete object silhouette, copper body and ivory highlights, shutter shape and slide rails, colors, brushwork, all three short cinnabar socket mouths and their positions (west/north/east), the internal short red grooves, and all safe margins. No additional lines, ports, objects, ornament, frame or shadow. Do not change the component into a whole board. Preserve genuine alpha outside the original object and no floor background. One single edited asset.
